urlaubskalender_nicht_verfuegbar.title: Vacation calendar of {person} not available
urlaubskalender_nicht_verfuegbar.description: HomeWake cannot read the vacation calendar {kalender} of {person} for more than 30 minutes. HomeWake keeps waking and uses the vacation days it read last (today and tomorrow at most). Please check the calendar or choose another one under HomeWake → {person} → Reconfigure. This notice disappears by itself as soon as the calendar can be read again.

feiertage_nicht_verfuegbar.title: Public holidays not available
feiertage_nicht_verfuegbar.description: HomeWake knows no public holidays for country {land} / region {region}. HomeWake keeps waking, but without public holidays. Please choose another country or region under HomeWake → Reconfigure.

schulferien_veraltet.title: School holiday data for {schule} is outdated
schulferien_veraltet.description: HomeWake has not been able to fetch the school holidays of {schule} from {anbieter} for a while. HomeWake keeps waking and uses the holidays loaded last (without any data: no school holidays). The notice disappears by itself after the next successful download.

raum_verloren.title: {person} no longer has a room
raum_verloren.description: The room of {person} was deleted or can no longer be assigned to persons. {person} is now inactive (no room): no room wakes {person}, and an active exception, if any, was deleted. Please choose a room in the room selection of {person}, or choose “no room” there on purpose. This notice then disappears by itself.

zeitplan_ungueltig_person.title: Schedule of {name} is invalid
zeitplan_ungueltig_person.description: The saved schedule of {name} cannot be read (damaged data). Until it is fixed, HomeWake does not calculate {name}: the entities of {name} are unavailable, and the room of {name} wakes according to the other persons or its default plan. Please open HomeWake → {name} → Reconfigure and save the schedule again. This notice disappears by itself as soon as the schedule is valid.

zeitplan_ungueltig_raum.title: Default plan of {name} is invalid
zeitplan_ungueltig_raum.description: The saved default plan of the room {name} cannot be read (damaged data). Until it is fixed, HomeWake does not calculate {name}: its entities are unavailable and the room does not wake. Persons assigned to {name} keep their room. Please open HomeWake → {name} → Reconfigure and save the default plan again. This notice disappears by itself as soon as the plan is valid.

geraet_fehlt.title: Devices of {raum} not found
geraet_fehlt.description: The room {raum} uses devices that Home Assistant does not know (deleted, renamed or disabled): {geraete}. HomeWake cannot switch them at wake-up time. Please add them again in Home Assistant, or choose other lights or another speaker under HomeWake → {raum} → Reconfigure. This notice disappears by itself as soon as all devices of the room are found.

favorit_fehlt_person.title: Radio favorite of {person} not found
favorit_fehlt_person.description: The radio favorite {favorit} of {person} is no longer in the favorites list of the speaker in {raum}. At wake-up time HomeWake plays the default favorite of the room instead or, if that is missing too, the first favorite of the list. Please choose another favorite in the radio favorite selection of {person}. This notice disappears by itself as soon as the favorite is back in the list or another one is chosen.

favorit_fehlt_raum.title: Default favorite of {raum} not found
favorit_fehlt_raum.description: The default favorite {favorit} of the room {raum} is no longer in the favorites list of its speaker. At wake-up time HomeWake plays the first favorite of the list instead, unless the person has a valid favorite. Please choose another default favorite for {raum}. This notice disappears by itself as soon as the favorite is back in the list or another one is chosen.

lautsprecher_ohne_liste.title: Speaker of {raum} has no favorites list
lautsprecher_ohne_liste.description: The speaker {lautsprecher} in {raum} did not report a favorites list (source_list) during the last wake-up, so HomeWake could not play any radio and waited in vain until the end of its attempts. Check in Home Assistant whether the speaker offers sources or favorites (for Sonos: favorites in the Sonos app), or choose another speaker under HomeWake → {raum} → Reconfigure. This notice disappears by itself as soon as the speaker reports a favorites list.
